0022600097.text: The Wizards host the Toronto Raptors, and neither team has a 2026-27 result on record yet. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot). In the 2025-26 season series, the Wizards lost 1-2, including a 134-125 loss in Washington on February 28, 2026.
